newsitem.title: USA: Horizon adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Horizon adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Horizon Mental Health Management Inc said Friday that after receiving stockholder approval of a rights agreement at its annual meeting on January 29, the company approved distribution of a dividend of one common stock purchase right for each outstanding share of its common stock.
The nontaxable dividend distribution will be made on March 4 to stockholders of record on February 19, the company said.
Horizon said each right will initially entitle the holder to purchase a share of common stock at an exercise price of $83.33.
The company said the rights will expire March 4, 2007.

They are designed to assure that stockholders are treated fairly in the event of any proposed takeover of the company and to guard against partial tender offers, open market accumulations and other abusive tactics to gain control of the company.
Horizon said it is not aware of any efforts to acquire it and the plan is only a precaution.
